_rule: Candidate instruments: every reading we could build on the methylation channel, each with the term of the law it reads, its substrate, its blind spot, its advantage, what would break it, and the next concrete step. The point is NOT to pick one - several instruments with different blind spots, agreeing on the same sample, is worth more than one instrument we trust. Priority is by (decides something) x (free or cheap) / (blocked). Written 2026-10-13 from the session that produced these ideas. Nothing here is sealed; an entry becomes a sealed test only through its own door note.
title: Candidate instruments, by priority

instruments.name: Territory contrast: fidelity in fragile territory over fidelity in stable territory
instruments.reads: WHERE the loss happens first; a sustained energy shortfall should take the late-replicating, solo-WCGW territory before it touches housekeeping promoters
instruments.cost: free (design, synthetic test, then existing arrays)
instruments.status: RUN ONCE 2026-10-13 (DEV-TERRITORY-01): the balance equation's parameter-free prediction of the response ratio, 4.158 from healthy baselines alone, was met to 1 % (measured 4.12-4.20 at shortfalls of 2-20 %), and the declared blind spot was confirmed; but the NUISANCE bar FAILED
instruments.open: v2: report both the difference and the normalized difference (one cancels each nuisance type), measure the beta-ceiling effect from fully held sites and subtract it, and leave composition to the mixture-predicted denominator the chain already uses
instruments.advantage: SELF-TARING; a ratio inside one array, so plate, batch and much of the composition effect cancel because numerator and denominator see the same cell mixture. It addresses the laboratory-to-laboratory spread that limits single whole-blood readings
instruments.blind: says nothing about absolute fidelity; a loss uniform across territories is invisible (confirmed, 0.1 % of the signal). And the practical failure: a difference cancels an ADDITIVE plate offset exactly but cannot cancel a MULTIPLICATIVE one; a 10 % composition change moves it about 5x what a 2 % shortfall does; while the beta = 1 ceiling makes offsets and noise one-sided
instruments.breaks: the ordering reversing; stable territory losing before fragile territory in a condition known to cost the cell energy
instruments.next: write DEV-TERRITORY-02 with the two-number signature and the measured ceiling floor, bars first

instruments.name: Met-A on whole blood: each cell in the mix, and the whole-sample reading
instruments.reads: total disorder above what the estimated cell mixture explains; the existing composition-aware reading, in a tube of blood
instruments.cost: free (one laptop read of arrays already on disk)
instruments.status: MEASURED on real healthy arrays, read by the chain itself (run_neutrophil, in the C-score band test), healthy people differ by 2.01 % (relative SD; 95th percentile +3.33 %), and the chain's leverage is 2.12 % of the reading per 1 % pattern loss, so about a 1.57 % loss clears the healthy 95th percentile. The first measurement (2026-10-13, 6.36 %) skipped the chain's self-tare step (Stage T step 1) and is withdrawn. GROUP ARM 2026-10-13 (DEV-GROUP-01): the sham passes; two healthy groups from two laboratories agree to 0.16 % after taring, but differ by 3.69 % UNTARED, at 6.5 standard errors. A group study is admissible only when patients and healthy comparisons are run in the SAME series. Read and flagged development: Met-A for each cell in a mix; and the every-site reading, more sensitive than the identity sites but unable to say which cell moved
instruments.open: per-person detection in whole blood, now open: the corrected spread is one laboratory's 23 arrays and one leverage array; a sealed per-person test across laboratories decides it
instruments.advantage: group comparisons are within reach NOW: with 50 people a mean loss of about 0.27 % separates the group from healthy, and the function already exists in the chain
instruments.blind: an array averages molecules before anyone reads them, so one cell type can never be isolated. Across laboratories without a shared series the raw reading carries a 3.7 % offset, which is inside the tumor range, so every comparison needs the same-series tare
instruments.breaks: healthy people differing by more than the leverage of the signal we are looking for (then arrays cannot carry blood and sequencing is required)
instruments.next: the every-site reading's healthy spread across Group-A's 278 bloods; then a sealed per-person test in whole blood, across laboratories

instruments.name: Distance to the ceiling
instruments.reads: how close a sample sits to the derived entropy ceiling; the right-hand mark of the gauge, past which the reading stops rising with further loss
instruments.cost: free (arithmetic on readings we already have)
instruments.status: the ceiling is in the foundation as derived. AUDIT DONE 2026-10-13 (DEV-CEILING-AUDIT-01): of 7,681 readings that record the flag, none is past the ceiling; the composition-aware path never recorded it, so the three sealed tissue results cannot be audited from saved files, and that gap could only have cost detections
instruments.open: re-read the three sealed tissue sets with the flag recorded (free, arrays on disk, reported as an audit that cannot change their sealed verdicts); and the reading itself; distance to the ceiling has still never been reported as a number
instruments.advantage: derived with no free parameter, and it answers how far from the ceiling a tumor arrives
instruments.blind: only informative for samples near the ceiling; says nothing about a healthy-range sample
instruments.breaks: a sample reading past the ceiling, which the derivation forbids
instruments.next: compute it for every sealed cancer reading already in the records and check none is past the turnover

instruments.name: Run-length spectrum of losses
instruments.reads: the SHAPE of clustering; exponential against heavy-tailed, which separates a processive mechanism from independent point losses
instruments.substrate: sequencing only (needs several sites on one molecule)
instruments.cost: laptop work on reads already in storage; no new sequencing
instruments.open: the derivation of the expected shape under each mechanism, then a synthetic test. Gated: the head-of-run bias the trim rule was written for (it held the earlier sequencing reading, since retired) must be checked on IAM-A's commissioned counter before a per-molecule reading spans laboratories
instruments.advantage: same data as the clustering meter, different question; distinguishes mechanism rather than only size
instruments.blind: impossible on arrays; needs depth, so shallow libraries are out
instruments.breaks: the measured shape matching neither mechanism's prediction in a case where the mechanism is known
instruments.next: after that check on IAM-A's commissioned counter

instruments.name: Tail of fragments in plasma (the early-detection instrument)
instruments.reads: the few badly disordered MOLECULES in a plasma sample, not the average; because early cancer is a tiny minority of fragments and an average hides it by construction
instruments.cost: box time per sample; the expensive one
instruments.open: the head-of-run check on IAM-A's commissioned counter, and a healthy plasma reference; the one-draw work builds toward it, and a public set of matched halves is held unread for the test that counts
instruments.advantage: the highest reward on the whole board; it is the blood test, and a tail statistic is the right shape for early detection
instruments.blind: needs depth and fragment length; a shallow or heavily fragmented sample has no tail to read. Composition of plasma is itself a question
instruments.breaks: the tail in healthy plasma being as heavy as in known cancer plasma
instruments.next: behind the head-of-run check and a healthy plasma reference

gate.name: Not an instrument: the trim rule, and the head-of-run check it calls for
gate.text: The earlier sequencing reading (Stage B) was held because the same kit read differently in two laboratories, and the cause is where in each file it read: at the head the failing libraries read 11-14 % below the controls read at the SAME position. Reading more places failed its planted test - pooling divides a bias rather than removing it. The remedy, DEV-IAMA-TRIM-01, excludes the unsettled head and decides how much from the raw reads' own chemistry (the non-CpG C-to-T fraction in windows, no alignment and no IAM-A): six planted bars, all met. That reading was since retired; IAM-A was commissioned on a different counter (Stage Q2). Whether the head-of-run bias touches the commissioned counter is checked before any per-molecule reading spans laboratories. Candidates 4 and 5 are both behind that check.

closing: Several instruments, each with a different blind spot, reading the same sample and agreeing - that is worth far more than one instrument we trust. Disagreement is also informative: a sample that reads normal on total disorder and abnormal on clustering is telling us which channel failed.
